scope: Bounded source/copy review of medical safety topics across 305 planned briefs (61 each A-E). Not clinical review or endorsement. No images edited or generated.

findings.issue: Concussion return wording omits explicit same-day exclusion.
findings.requested: State no same-day return after suspected concussion and healthcare clearance before return; cite CDC response.

findings.issue: Traumatic neck pain/weakness or suspected neck injury needs direct emergency response, not conditional serious-injury wording.
findings.requested: Keep still and call emergency services; add AAOS cervical fracture source.

findings.issue: Heat confusion/collapse footer activates emergency services but omits time-critical cooling.
findings.requested: Add start cooling alongside emergency call.

findings.issue: Treatment-specific source needed for cold-water immersion.
findings.requested: Add NATA exertional heat illnesses position statement.

findings.issue: Add focused source supporting inability to bear weight.
Soft-tissue source does not substantiate concussion removal.
Original NIAID patient PDF returned 403 during audit; accessible primary panel report supports copy.

universal_review.result: Emergency action plan activation/AED location language has no material unsafe instruction.
Unresponsiveness plus abnormal breathing, emergency call, AED and CPR align with AHA.
Immediate emergency call, avoiding unnecessary movement and dispatcher instruction align with AAOS spine response.
Emergency call and rapid cooling by trained responders with airway protection are appropriate; treatment-specific source requested.
Prompt prescribed epinephrine and immediate emergency activation supported; no dose instructions invented.

other_checks.infection: C-001/002/003/028 align with CDC early care, wound covering, hygiene and shared-water restrictions.
other_checks.urgent_injury: Inability to bear weight, deformity/numbness and worsening head symptoms routed to medical care; no advice to play through symptoms.

notifications: Findings sent to parent and relevant generation agents. E confirmed concussion updates; C confirmed cooling update. A/D updates require parent integration confirmation.

resolution.status: All flagged corrections reported resolved in final selected images and manifests; checked by production agents. Individual clinician review remains pending.
